arguments.command:
cd /home/runner/work/pi-action/pi-action; git checkout -q -b fix/42-duplicate-replies; git add -A; git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
fix: tell pi that pi-action posts its reply, so it doesn't post it twice

In comment mode, pi-action posts pi's final response as a comment. Nothing
told pi this, and its tools have a token that can comment (GH_TOKEN). In
#39, pi posted its reply with `gh issue comment` and then pi-action posted
the final response too: two answers seconds apart.

The built-in first message now has a "## Your Reply" section, and each
follow-up and answer ends with a short reminder, so threads that began
before this change get it too. Output mode and direct prompts are unchanged.

Fixes #42
EOF
npx --no -- commitlint --from origin/main --to HEAD && git push -q -u origin fix/42-duplicate-replies 2>&1 | tail -2
